To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

systematic reviews are an important methodological tool for psychological scientists, and that there are several key steps in conducting a systematic review that can be used as a guide to help ensure that the review is conducted in a rigorous and transparent manner.

1) systematic reviews can be conducted using either a quantitative or a qualitative approach and that the approach used should be determined by the research question; 2) a systematic review is a rigorous, replicable, and transparent method for synthesizing and integrating research; 3) systematic reviews can help clarify whether and how research results replicate; and 4) systematic reviews are essential to the scientific enterprise.
the replication crisis is not a crisis, and that the replication rate in psychological science is similar to that of other sciences.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: What are the characteristics of a systematic review that is well designed and well reported?

the following questions: (a) How can systematic reviews help to address the replication crisis? (b) How can systematic review methodology be used to improve the quality of psychological research? (c) What are the core standards and principles of systematic reviews? and (d) How do systematic reviews differ from traditional narrative literature reviews?
the development and evaluation of a systematic review methodology to assess the quality of the evidence for a given research question.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evidence is strong, and that it has been shown that systematic reviews are the gold standard in the field of evidence-based medicine.
systematic reviews are an important and useful methodology that is currently underutilized. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2019 APA, all rights reserved)
systematic reviews provide the best way to summarize the state of knowledge in a field, to identify gaps in the evidence, and to guide future research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

systematic reviews can be an important tool in the replication toolbox, and they can help us understand whether and why findings are replicable. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2018 APA, all rights reserved)
systematic reviews can be used to address the question of whether and how research is replicable and can be used to help understand why it is not replicable.

the systematic reviews are a powerful methodology to clarify whether and how research is replicable, and that the replication crisis can be solved through systematic reviews. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2021 APA, all rights reserved)
The main takeaway from our work is that
systematic reviews can be conducted in many subject areas and disciplines and can provide important insights about how to interpret research findings.
systematic reviews can be a valuable tool to improve science and that researchers have a responsibility to conduct them.
systematic reviews are an effective way to synthesize and integrate evidence and to identify gaps in knowledge. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2019 APA, all rights reserved)
